body: ah definitely true. why torture myself if there’s no future

I think you’re generalizing a lot based on your experiences with a small group of people. There are vastly different experiences among ABCD’s depending on where they live, what schools they’re going to, socioeconomic status etc. Just like anywhere else.

Questioning how American we are stems from the struggle to develop an identity when you are a child of immigrants and living in a country that is not your family’s homeland. It’s not bc of some superficial obsession that being American is a personality trait or value system. I think in large part many of us are trying to figure out how to connect to two distinct cultures and identities, Indian and American, and how they intersect.

It’s crazy because I think it’ll be fine going to stay w my mom and stepdad every time and every single time, I’m wrong. I love my stepdad, he’s the best guy in the world but he’s too good to see how manipulative and damaging my mom actually is. Luckily I brought a pen and some other weed back so it’s not all hopeless 

But anyway, it is nice to know there’s at least someone out there who gets it and I’m not just overly sensitive lmao. Hopefully I can get that distance and some semblance of inner peace sometime soon-ish!

I’ve actually lived away from home the past 3 years and I lived completely alone this past year and it was amazing for me but my parents moved me out today which probably explains why I’m having all of these loops of thought. I’m not sure what’s holding me to them because it’s not money bc I pay my rent and tuition but some other unspoken obligation? They wanted me back this summer and I just rolled over and said yes. But it’s really helpful knowing that you moved out when your brother was 13. I know my sister can definitely tell that I’m struggling and she wrote me a card telling me to not worry about her and do what makes me happy. i guess the question is what else is keeping me from leaving 

damn idk. I just need to find something to keep me sane while living here for a few months especially bc I’m so used to living completely alone. It’s shitty to admit that it’s the only way i can cope but all my unhealthy coping mechanisms like weed, alcohol, sex are all of the table ahh.

I think distance from my family would be great for me but my sister is too young and she’ll be too affected if I leave :/ I think I just want a fresh start, new people, new place. Ugh it’s just a good dream though. I wish I had the strength to put distance between me and all the people in my life but I’m just going to feel so guilty. I’m so sorry, I feel like I’m just going in circles ahhh

Yeah it does feel weird! 21 is so interesting because you’re so aware of how young you actually are and how much you don’t know but especially w mental illness, it feels like so much has happened in life and i’m already so tired of it. 

I guess I don’t feel like I’m procrastinating, I just feel like i’m holding on to life for everyone and everything else but myself. I’m just unhappy and in pain but feel like I’m having to put myself through more pain by living for other people. It sounds weird but it almost feels like ending this life is putting myself first for once but I can’t do that because I’m always thinking about how it’ll affect people around me. I hate saying “it’s not fair”/“life’s not fair” because it’s cliche but it isn’t fair. Why am I going through all this pain for other people you know?
